tools_intro: avenir-mcp declares these tools. Read-only tools are always available; write tools exist only with `AVENIR_MCP_WRITE=1`, and every one of them but `import_transactions` is previewed and confirmed; `approve_transactions` asks first when it approves by dates, and applies given ids at once.
errors_description: Every error message avenir-mcp can return, tool by tool.
errors_intro: An error comes back as a tool result with `isError`, and its message says what to fix, so that the agent can correct its call. Placeholders in braces stand for the value that was passed.
general_text: Any tool that reaches YNAB can return YNAB's own error: `Error calling tool '<tool>': YNAB <status>: <detail>` — for example `YNAB 401` for a wrong or revoked token, `YNAB 429` when the 200 requests per hour are spent. A `401` answer carries avenir-mcp's own detail instead of YNAB's: `YNAB 401: the token is invalid or was revoked; create a new Personal Access Token in YNAB's settings.` When YNAB answers nothing at all, the message says whether anything may have changed: a read says that YNAB could not be reached and that nothing was changed, and a write that had already been sent says that the change may or may not be applied and has to be checked before anything is tried again. Without `YNAB_API_KEY`, the server refuses to call YNAB: `YNAB_API_KEY environment variable is not set`.

Ohne `YNAB_API_KEY` weigert sich der Server, YNAB aufzurufen: `YNAB_API_KEY environment variable is not set`.
